newsitem.title: INDIA: India sugar rises on slow supplies, higher freight.
newsitem.headline: India sugar rises on slow supplies, higher freight.

text.p: Indian sugar prices rose on Friday as supplies were hit by higher freight charges ahead of nationwide strike by transport operators, traders said.
Truckers plan a nationwide strike from April 1 to protest the imposition of a service tax and higher insurance premiums.
Road freight charges from producing centres to the Bombay market have nearly doubled to 40/50 rupees per quintal, a trader said.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 rose 20/40 rupees to 1300/1350 per quintal, while M-30 gained 15/50 to 1330/1450.
